versions.changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-skill-vetter-workflow-helper

- Helps users implement Skill Vetter-style workflows for bug fixing, setup hardening, safety improvements, reliability, and adjacent skills.
- Responds to validated, broad demand (supported by 9 online signals across 3 source families).
- Provides step-by-step guidance: restates user goals, generates concise plans, minimizes manual coordination, and produces local-hardware-friendly outputs.
- Outputs include tailored artifacts, reusable checklists or workflows, and validation notes.
- Includes clear triggers and criteria to ensure relevant, actionable, and verifiable support.
